- **Finding**: Inside `publication-binding.json`, all 18 `published_files` entries (lines 21–40) and all 35 `supplemental_files` entries (lines 72–108, including `ROADMAP.md`, `docs/SHERLOCK-CORRECTNESS-LOOP.md`, `docs/SHERLOCK-IMPLEMENTATION-PLAN.md`, `docs/SHERLOCK-REFERENCE-STATUS.md`, and `raw/assignments/moriarty-stagenet-acceptance-2026-10-15.md`) match the exact SHA-256 digests of the files at `8ce7dc2c`. In `SHA256SUMS`, 18 of 19 lines match their files, but line 10 records `406ba1a45673343b99ceac5265ce329e1053a6e58495d3a540d7ac9d6b3f5230  publication-binding.json` whereas the actual SHA-256 of `publication-binding.json` is `de19f74d00c03dbdfd7ee7bcb71b523f15abbbcb42ff91038831fd4e3e9739b8`. Running `sha256sum -c SHA256SUMS` fails on `publication-binding.json`.
- **Concrete Fix**: Update [openspec/changes/sherlock-universal-interpreter-design/SHA256SUMS](file:///home/charl/Moriarty/.worktrees/sherlock-trace-compare-20261015/openspec/changes/sherlock-universal-interpreter-design/SHA256SUMS#L10) line 10 to:
  ```text
  de19f74d00c03dbdfd7ee7bcb71b523f15abbbcb42ff91038831fd4e3e9739b8  publication-binding.json
  ```
